definitions.explanation: The process of saving or writing data to storage media such as hard drives, USB drives, or CDs.
A message, comment, or entry posted on an online forum, message board, or comment section.

examples.japanese: データの{書|か}き{込|こ}み{中|ちゅう}だ。
USBへの{書|か}き{込|こ}みに{失敗|しっぱい}した。
examples.english: Failed to write to the USB drive.

examples.japanese: {書|か}き{込|こ}み{禁止|きんし}のファイルです。
{掲示板|けいじばん}に{書|か}き{込|こ}みをする。
examples.english: To post on a message board.

examples.japanese: {悪質|あくしつ}な{書|か}き{込|こ}みは{削除|さくじょ}される。
{書|か}き{込|こ}みへの{返信|へんしん}が{来|き}た。
examples.english: I got a reply to my post.

notes:
{書|か}き{込|こ}み has two main meanings: writing data to storage, and posting online.

SENSE 1 - DATA WRITING:
- {書|か}き{込|こ}み{中|ちゅう}: writing/saving
- {書|か}き{込|こ}み{禁止|きんし}: write-protected
- {書|か}き{込|こ}み{速度|そくど}: write speed

SENSE 2 - ONLINE POSTING:
- {書|か}き{込|こ}みをする: to post, to comment
- {匿名|とくめい}{書|か}き{込|こ}み: anonymous post
- {書|か}き{込|こ}み{欄|らん}: comment section

USAGE NOTE:
- In online contexts, {書|か}き{込|こ}み is commonly shortened to {書き込み|かきこ} or {カキコ}
